provenance.method: UnityPy static scene/asset parsing plus manual serialized MonoBehaviour field decoding using retained class declarations; no bundled executable or DLL executed

bindings: Unity MonoScript path ID and class/namespace/assembly read statically

field_decoding.provider_fields: serialized PPtrs in field declaration order; validated against raw object size 140 and retained RoomsViewProvider field offsets
field_decoding.room_view_fields: ARoomView float/array/PPtr fields decoded in declaration order; derived fields decoded from each concrete class's serialized declarations
field_decoding.narrative_fields: enum, UIButton PPtr, UTF-8 string, Vector2 in retained field order
field_decoding.image_sprite_field: UnityEngine.UI.Image m_Sprite PPtr at byte offset 88, matched only when PPtr resolves to a Sprite in sharedassets0/1
field_decoding.hierarchy_transform_fields: Transform/RectTransform local position, local quaternion rotation, and local scale read directly from UnityPy typetree

provenance.interaction_bounds: Unity UIButton checks sprite alpha after camera-aware RectTransform conversion; exported rect data is source geometry only and is not asserted as the click mask

interaction_region.method: camera-aware RectTransform conversion followed by sprite alpha sampling
